hooks.command: diff -q "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || (cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --omit=dev && cp package.json "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json") ; "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/install-stripe-cli.sh" || echo 'stripe-cli provisioning deferred'
